title: M/S Savari Ice Factory v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: V.K. Shukla, J.; Suneet Kumar, J.
disposition: Liberty to apply under clause 6.14; authority to decide within two months.
headnote: The High Court will not itself grant installment facility for electricity dues. Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 leaves that facility for a consumer in financial distress to the authority concerned. The writ petitioner was given liberty to apply under clause 6.14, with a direction that any such application be decided in accordance with law within two months.
facts: M/s Savari Ice Factory filed a writ petition against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and others before the Allahabad High Court in respect of an outstanding electricity amount. When the petition was taken up, counsel for the petitioner stated that the consumer was prepared to pay the entire amount in question but sought installment facility. The respondents were represented. The Court was not asked to quash the demand on merits, but to extend installments for payment of the amount.

holding_units.holding: Under clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, installment facility for a consumer in financial distress may be extended by the authority concerned, not by the High Court. The Court declined to itself accord installments and granted liberty to apply under clause 6.14; any such application is to be dealt with and decided in accordance with law on the records within two months of production of a certified copy of the order.

principle_tags.application: Clause 6.14 permits installment facility where the consumer is in financial distress, but the High Court will not itself extend it; the consumer must apply to the authority concerned.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner is in financial distress and should be granted installment facility under clause 6.14
not_decided.note: Left to the authority concerned to decide in accordance with law on the records.

not_decided.point: Merits of the outstanding electricity amount
not_decided.note: Not examined; the petitioner offered to pay the entire amount if installments were extended.
